name: Uruusawa Akemi
source:
She is one of the instructors in charge of the main character. An intelligent beauty who looks good with glasses. She is polite and serious, but she is also inflexible. she is a member of the driving school's discipline, and is regarded by other instructors (or rather, annoyed by her.) He is also an excellent instructor, and conducts polite and gentle lessons. However, if something unexpected happens, she becomes very upset. Mieko is a natural enemy.

[From Getchu.]
